Resolves #21902

The six live previews of the v10 State Provider and Functional Components deep dives run again. Their imports use the convention every other preview in `learn/` follows (`'../button/Base.mjs'`, `'../functional/_export.mjs'`) instead of bare `'neo.mjs'` specifiers, which nothing on the preview's path resolves. Two demos had also drifted from the API behind that first error, and now match it:

- The functional state-provider demo declares `className` and `stateProvider` inside `config`, as `defineComponent` requires, and its bindings read `data` instead of a `config.data` that components do not have.
- In the task list, the store gets a model with its fields, and the list gets a `displayField`, a `ListModel` and the List's `select` event in place of a `selectionChange` the List never fires. The List now has an id of its own, so a click on a task selects it, and the two panes sit side by side.

Evidence: L3 (the previews run headless and by hand in a local Portal on this branch, beside the released page on neomjs.com) → L3 required (both ACs are rendered previews). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | outside-CI: the #21870 probe (it opens each page, clicks every Preview tab and reads the panel) on this branch: State Provider 5/5 and Functional Components 1/1 render their demo with no error text. Before: six resolver errors locally, and empty or garbled panels on neomjs.com. The task list selects the second task on a click and shows its title and description in the details pane. |
| AC-2 | outside-CI: an awk pass over every `live-preview` block in `learn/` finds no `from 'neo.mjs…'` import. The same pass on `dev` lists the 14 import lines of the six blocks. The posts' static blocks (lines 21 and 108 of the functional-components post) still carry theirs, untouched. |

## Deltas from ticket

- The ticket expected imports only. Behind the import error, two demos failed on API drift: `defineComponent requires a config object with a className.`, and `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'removeDom')` from a list whose records had no `name`. Both demos changed beyond their import lines, as described above.
- The task list's List gets `id: 'task-list'`. Without it the functional component generates `neo-functional-component-1__0`, and `List#getItemRecordId` splits item ids on `__`, so a click resolved to record `'0'` and selected nothing. Julia's review traced this and filed the engine half as #21965. The demo's root also gets `display: flex`, its details pane takes `flex` inside its `style`, and the list is 300 px wide so its titles fit.

## Test Evidence

The Functional Components post's task list at 1440×900, after a click on its Preview tab and then on the second task.

| As released (neomjs.com) | As changed (this branch) |
|---|---|
| ![released](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/3dd5890cd658a7406f313114c889c0d35b47650c/review-evidence/21902/task-list-preview-released.jpg?raw=true) | ![changed](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/756cf1129377ffe8b0e6a5be6348c85eeea14b38/review-evidence/21902/task-list-preview-selected.jpg?raw=true) |

As released, the panel reads `Failed to resolve module specifier 'neo.mj../../esm/o.mjs'`: the `dist/production` rebase cuts the bare specifier apart. As changed, the three tasks render beside the details pane, and "Create a new reactivity system" is selected (`aria-selected="true"`) with its title and description in the pane.

Frame critique: the selected item reads by its outline only; the list's selected colour is the theme's. The preview panel keeps empty space below the two panes, which is the live-preview container's fixed height, not the demo's.

- [ ] On the deployed Portal, both posts' previews render their demos, and a click selects a task in the task list.
